Elheen keeps every enquiry, quote and payment in one place, and tells you each morning who to follow up, with the message already written.

Sending the quote is not the end of the sale. It is the middle.

Most clients are not saying no. They are busy, comparing, or waiting for a nudge. Three short, polite messages are usually enough to get a real answer:

Day 2: did you get a chance to look at it?
Day 5: would you like to change anything?
Day 10: shall I close it, or keep it open?

Elheen reminds you on each day and writes the message for you.

Save this and try it on your open quotes this week.

No more PDFs that disappear in a WhatsApp chat.

With Elheen you send a link. Your client opens a clean quote with your name, your TRN and 5% VAT, and accepts it by typing their name. You get an alert the moment they open it, and another when they accept.

They can also save it as a PDF or ask you a question on WhatsApp.

A free site visit can cost you half a day.

Before you go, ask four simple questions: budget, start date, property type and a few photos. Serious clients answer them happily. People who are only collecting prices usually do not.

In Elheen these questions are built into your enquiry link, and each lead is marked as a good fit or one to check, based on your smallest job.

Save this for your team.

The simple rule: price the extra work and get it approved in writing before you start. Every time, even for small things.

In Elheen you send it as a short quote on WhatsApp. The client approves it with their name, and it is added to the job and its payments automatically.
